Package aor.proj3t.dto

Class UserDTO

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.dto.UserDTO
public class UserDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object for User entity.

Represents a comprehensive user profile containing personal, contact, and employment-related data. This DTO is commonly used across authentication flows, administrative dashboards, and user directories. JAXB annotations support XML serialization for compatibility with XML-based APIs and integrations.

Attributes: - id: Unique identifier of the user - email: Primary contact email address - firstName: User's given name - lastName: User's family name or surname - phoneNumber: Contact number (optional) - address: User’s residence or mailing address - birthdate: Date of birth in ISO format - biography: Optional user-provided short bio or summary - createdAt: Timestamp when the account was created - photograph: Reference to the user’s profile image (e.g., filename or URL) - role: Enum indicating the user's role (e.g., EMPLOYEE, MANAGER, ADMIN) - manager: Lightweight representation of the user's assigned manager - workplace: Workplace or department assigned to the user Common use cases: - Registration and profile editing - Admin-level user management - Generating profile exports and audits
